scientific_integrity: The positive direction proves maximal p-mean convergence by a Potter-bound truncation at the de Bruijn scale, independent maximal L2 control, and a uniform tail p-moment estimate. The negative direction explicitly constructs symmetric three-point independent rows with Cesàro uniform integrability and vanishing spike probability but divergent maximal p-moments. Numerical examples check the construction and do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence is universal over rowwise independent triangular arrays, with positive slowly varying weights locally bounded above and away from zero. It does not classify dependent arrays or arbitrary fixed single sequences. The existence of an equivalent older monotone-envelope or Orlicz-weight classification remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Almost-increasing slow variation is the exact Cesàro-\(L^p\) upgrade boundary
